description: Free price for a Motion video made from a short brief and the Brand Kit. Spends nothing. Pass durationSec (15-60, default 15) and format (9:16, 16:9 or 1:1); use the same values for soclo_motion_video_make. Returns credits and a quoteId to show the account owner.

format.description: Defaults to 9:16 portrait. Use the same value for the quote and the make.
